description:
**CosmoMask #16403**

 By owning a [CosmoMask NFT](https://thecosmomasks.com/?utm_source=OpenSea&utm_medium=mask_description), you accumulate a [CosmoMasks Power (CMP)](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0xB9FDc13F7f747bAEdCc356e9Da13Ab883fFa719B) every day. That allows you to choose a name for your NFT on the Ethereum Blockchain and earn [COSMO](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0x27cd7375478F189bdcF55616b088BE03d9c4339c) on the [CosmoSwap.space](https://cosmoswap.space/farms?utm_source=OpenSea&utm_medium=mask_description).

 Be the first owner of a CosmoMask and get a bonus of 10,000 [COSMO](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0x27cd7375478F189bdcF55616b088BE03d9c4339c) and 1,830 [CMP](https://info.uniswap.org/token/0xB9FDc13F7f747bAEdCc356e9Da13Ab883fFa719B) for each mask!

**Skyenat**

This is Skyenti planet inhabited by Skyenats. Here white spheres fly in space, containing inside everything that has happened, like our history books, however, you can't rewrite, change or erase anything, the information is securely stored. The world of the Skyenats has no top or bottom. They live inside the planet, it is a hollow sphere, in its space "float" all the inhabitants. They, like us, can love and hate, can build and destroy, but, thanks to these spheres, have great wisdom and rarely repeat the mistakes of the past. They perfectly analyze the information available to each inhabitant, so each "mistake" is the result of a completely new experience. They try to leave positive experiences in everyday life. Wise and very happy Skyenats.
